agent_explanation: Controller-driven body (hover, ignores gravity) is pushed left at ~9.3 m/s into a thin vertical wall (w≈0.346) with fmax≈42.95 at vcmd≈11.46. The collision resolver uses impulses plus positional correction, but with persistent force and 2 substeps per dt≈0.004 it fails to eject the body. Penetration grows from 0.062 at step 350 to 0.138 at step 352 to 0.175 at step 353, exceeding the 0.15 limit. Lowering fmax to 5 removes the failure, confirming sustained controller force overcomes the wall correction.
